In the night a strong storm blew. In the morning, people found the road to school covered with leaves and branches.

In the middle of it lay a big branch from a cactus, full of thorns, fallen right across the road.

Suhaib and his friend Yusuf came by. Suhaib jumped over it and said, "Careful, Yusuf — its thorns are long."

Yusuf jumped over after him, and they went on to school.

The next day they found the branch still in its place. People walked around it, to the right and the left, and no one picked it up.

Yusuf said, "Shouldn't we move it, Suhaib?"

Suhaib said, "We didn't throw it there, so why should we move it? Whoever it belongs to can pick it up."

On the third day, Uncle Na'im came by — an old man with weak eyesight, walking to the masjid before Dhuhr.

He did not see the branch. He tripped over it and fell on his side, and the thorns scratched his leg.

Suhaib and Yusuf were on their way back from school. They ran to him, helped him up, and brushed the dust off his clothes.

Uncle Na'im said, rubbing his leg, "It's all right, boys. But whoever moves this branch will have a great reward."
Then he told them, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'While a man was walking along a road, he found a thorny branch on the road and moved it aside, so Allah thanked him and forgave him.'"

Suhaib looked at Yusuf, and Yusuf looked at Suhaib.

Then Suhaib said quietly, "Yusuf wanted to move it yesterday… and I said no."

Suhaib wrapped his hands in the end of his bag, and Yusuf took hold of the other end. Together they dragged the branch off the road and threw it into the field.

Then they gathered the stones the storm had rolled onto the road and put them at the side.

Uncle Na'im walked along the road, which was now clear, and smiled, saying, "Now I can walk without being afraid."

And he made du'a for them all the way to the masjid.

From that day on, Suhaib walked to school with his eyes on the ground. Whenever he saw a stone, or broken glass, or thorns, he moved it off the road.

And Yusuf would say, "Now you see the road better than I do!"

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "While a man was walking along a road, he found a thorny branch on the road and moved it aside, so Allah thanked him and forgave him."

📖 Agreed upon (Al-Bukhari and Muslim). This is a tale told as a parable; it did not happen to anyone in particular.
